Assist.Army.Hint.Coordinate: Hex index (row × map width + column). A unit's position is the hex it was placed on, so this is read-only; move units with copy / paste.
Assist.Army.Hint.UnitType: Unit type ID (the Army field of ArmySettings.json); click ▼ to search by name
Assist.Army.Hint.General: General ID (GeneralSettings.json), 0 = no general; click ▼ to search by name
Assist.Army.Hint.Rank: Military rank; 1–11 when the unit has a general
Assist.Army.Hint.HpLevel: General HP level (the name plate above the unit); 1–4 when the unit has a general
Assist.Army.Hint.Skill: Level 1–5 of the general's skill {0}; 0 when the general has no such skill
Assist.Army.Hint.OccupationEvent: Event triggered when this unit's hex is captured, 0 = none
Assist.Army.Hint.DeathDialogue: Event triggered when the unit is destroyed, 0 = none
Assist.Army.Hint.LevelMark: 0 hidden, 9 shield mark (stock maps mostly use 1)
Assist.Army.Hint.Hatred: AI hatred; stock maps mostly use -1
Assist.Army.Hint.AntiDefense: Minimum distance that makes a holding unit move and attack
Assist.Army.Hint.Medal: Medal; special medals use type + level
Assist.Army.Hint.Ribbon: Ribbon; subtract 2 for types starting with 3
Assist.Army.Hint.Unknown: Meaning not confirmed; kept as is
Assist.Army.Hint.Waste: Not used in v3 (badges in v1); kept as is
Assist.Army.Status.Errors: {0} invalid field(s); fix them before pressing OK
Assist.Army.Status.Warnings: {0} field(s) break game rules (warning only, you can still save)
Assist.Army.Status.Keys: Enter: next field · Ctrl+Enter: OK · Esc: cancel
Assist.Army.General.FillTooltip: Fill rank, HP level and skill levels from this general's data (saved when you press OK)
Assist.Army.Rule.NoUnitType: With no unit type, level, organization and general should be 0
Assist.Army.Rule.UnknownUnitType: Unit type {0} is not in ArmySettings.json
Assist.Army.Rule.HealthBonus: HP bonus should be at least 1 (100 = 100%)
Assist.Army.Rule.NoGeneral: Should be 0 when there is no general
